plan: A very mobile swordsman who knocks enemies up with a tornado then leaps onto them with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His Q (Steel Tempest). After two successful hits with his Q, the third throws a tornado that knocks you up and opens up his R.
contrer: When his tornado is ready, stay out of its line of fire: no knock-up, no R.
Wait until he has used his wind wall (W) before throwing your projectiles.
Attack him once his passive shield is down: it only recharges while he moves.
forces: Very mobile by dashing through minions with his E.
Blocks all projectiles with his wind wall (W).
His R can hit several knocked-up enemies.
faiblesses: Fragile when hit by crowd control.
Hard to play without minions or enemies to dash through.
His R only works on a knocked-up enemy.

sorts.P: Increased critical strikes and a shield that charges as he moves.
sorts.Q: Thrust in a line; the 3rd throws a tornado that knocks up.
sorts.W: Wall that blocks all enemy projectiles.
sorts.E: Dashes through an enemy; reusable on different targets.
sorts.R: Leaps onto a knocked-up enemy and keeps them airborne.

momentFort: Strong in duels from the start, fearsome in the mid game with his critical strike items.
